questions.question_text: According to classical free electron theory, in the absence of external electrical field, the free electrons __________
options: Move randomly and collide with each other
questions.answer: In the absence of a field, electrons move in random directions due to thermal energy and undergo frequent collisions with lattice ions.

questions.question_text: A hole in the semiconductors treated as __________
options: A incomplete part of covalent bond
questions.answer: A hole is effectively an empty state in the valence band created by the absence of an electron in a covalent bond.
questions.chapter: Unit 2- Carrier Transport Mechanism in Semiconductors

questions.question_text: A unit of vibrational energy due to oscillating atoms within a crystal is known as __________
questions.answer: Phonons are the discrete units (quanta) of lattice vibrations in a crystal.

questions.question_text: The probability of finding the electron at E = Ef at 100 K
questions.answer: According to the Fermi-Dirac distribution f(E) = 1 / [exp((E-Ef)/kT) + 1], at E=Ef, f(E) = 1/2 or 50% for any T > 0.

questions.question_text: The Fermi level of n-type semiconductor __________ while increasing temperature
questions.answer: As temperature increases, the semiconductor becomes more intrinsic, causing the Fermi level in an n-type material to move downward toward the middle of the bandgap.
questions.chapter: Unit 2- Carrier Transport Mechanism in Semiconductors

questions.question_text: The Fermi level in a p-semiconductor located at __________
options: The top of the valence band
The top of the conduction band
The bottom of the valence band
The bottom of the conduction band
questions.answer: In p-type semiconductors, the Fermi level is situated just above the top of the valence band at low temperatures.
questions.chapter: Unit 2- Carrier Transport Mechanism in Semiconductors

questions.question_text: A photon of frequency v interact with electrons and holes of specific energies and momentum is determined by __________
questions.answer: The E-k (energy vs. wave vector) diagram illustrates the relationship between energy and crystal momentum for carriers.

questions.question_text: Fermi’s golden rule which describes the optical __________
questions.answer: Fermi's Golden Rule is a mathematical formula used to calculate the transition rate (probability per unit time) of a quantum system.

questions.question_text: If the voltage of the potential barrier is V0. A voltage V is applied to the input, at what moments will the barrier disappears?
questions.answer: The built-in potential barrier (V0) is overcome when the applied forward bias (V) exceeds it.
questions.chapter: Unit 2- Carrier Transport Mechanism in Semiconductors

questions.question_text: Which process gives the laser its special properties as an optical source?
questions.answer: Laser (Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation) relies on stimulated emission to produce coherent, monochromatic light.

questions.question_text: Short circuit current (Isc) in solar cell due to
questions.answer: Short circuit current is the maximum current that a solar cell can deliver when its terminals are connected with zero resistance.

questions.question_text: If the positive terminal of the battery is connected to the anode of the diode, then it is kwn as __________
questions.answer: Connecting the positive terminal to the p-region (anode) and negative to the n-region (cathode) constitutes forward biasing.
questions.chapter: Unit 2- Carrier Transport Mechanism in Semiconductors

questions.question_text: How many times should a Monte Carlo simulation model be run?
questions.answer: Monte Carlo simulations rely on statistical sampling, requiring a large number of trials to achieve accuracy and minimize variance.

questions.question_text: To identify the nature of semiconductor (p-type or n – type) __________ method will be used.
questions.answer: The Hall effect determines the sign and density of charge carriers, identifying whether a material is p-type or n-type.

questions.question_text: In linear four probe method the tip of probe diameter is usually __________ than the probe spacing
questions.answer: To minimize geometric errors in resistivity calculation, probe tips should be small relative to the spacing.

questions.question_text: The Hall voltage is __________
options: Perpendicular to electric and magnetic field
Parallel to electric and magnetic field
questions.answer: Hall voltage is generated in a direction perpendicular to both the electric current and the applied magnetic field (Lorentz force direction).

questions.question_text: Nano particles are special mainly because of their __________
questions.answer: High surface area per unit volume at the nanoscale leads to unique properties not found in bulk forms.

questions.question_text: Which among the following helps us in getting a 3D picture of the specimen?
questions.answer: Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) produces 3D-like images of the surface topography of a sample.

questions.question_text: In PVD chamber, the precursors are introduced to the reaction chamber in the __________ state
questions.answer: In Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD), the material to be deposited starts in a solid state and is vaporized physically.

questions.question_text: The physical parameter that is probed in AFM resulting from different interactions is
questions.answer: AFM measures atomic forces between the scanning tip and the surface.
